adjudication_label: Trace impurity quantification and MSRE comparison
canonical_question: How do the trace metal impurity levels in the purified FLiBe compare to those reported in the MSRE salt data?

question_variants.question: How do the trace metal impurity levels in the purified FLiBe compare to those reported in the MSRE salt data?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The trace metal impurity levels (specifically Cr and Ni) in the purified salts were found to be comparable to those reported in MSRE salt data.

answers.answer: The concentrations of common corrosion products such as Cr and Ni in the purified FLiBe were comparable to salts produced during the MSRE.
answers.measurement_outcome: Comparable concentrations of Cr and Ni
answers.boundary_limitation: Only specifies Cr and Ni as comparable.
evidence_spans: In order to confirm the above findings, CALPHAD calculations were performed to determine all the equilibrium phases for the Cr 18 Mn 27 Fe 27.5 Ni 27.5 alloy.
At 700 °C, the alloy is expected to contain both FCC and BCC phases.
The BCC phase is approximately 4% in phase fraction and is rich in Cr and low in Ni with nominal composition of Cr 67 Fe 13 Mn 18.5 Ni 1.5 .
